description: Find out who owns or controls a company: its parent chain, ultimate parent and subsidiaries. By LEI or company name, returns official GLEIF Level 2 data (CC0): direct and ultimate accounting-consolidation parents, reporting exceptions explaining a missing parent, and direct and ultimate subsidiaries with counts. Only entities with an LEI; this is accounting consolidation, not beneficial ownership. Use for KYB, credit or group-exposure checks. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: lei_ownership_tree
